usedFor: Todoist holds the to-dos and Planable drafts social posts, so “New Complete Task” can start a post with “Create Post”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Complete Task” in Todoist, then “Create Post” in Planable
bestTemplate.why: A finished content task becomes a post in Planable, ready for the team to review.

watchOut: “Project Created” is polling, so a template that starts on it runs “Create Post” after a scheduled check.
